{{Quote|I wonder where Mendo got to..."<br />"He better be inside. Otherwise, he'll be in real trouble.|Rei and Taru|<ref name="marvel96" />}}
'''Mendo''' was a [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] guard assigned to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] [[Lumiya]]'s base on the planet [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]], alongside fellow Nagai [[Taru]] and [[Rei]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Mendo was keeping watch outside the base when he was stabbed through the chest by the [[Iskalonian]] [[Kiro]], an [[Alliance of Free Planets]] agent who was attempting to rescue [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a captive of Lumiya's. Rei and Taru searched for their missing comrade, and both met similar fates.<ref name="marvel96" />
